title: Rabbit Hole production acceptance: owner checklist
rules: Sign in as yourself in a normal browser. Use ONE throwaway canvas named "acceptance 1026" for every step that writes data; delete it at the end (O15).
Do NOT press Generate on any Motion or image card, and do not confirm /video. Nothing here needs paid generation.
Stop at the first FAIL of an item, write what you saw, take one screenshot, go to the next item. A FAIL does not end the sitting.
Write PASS only for what you saw. If you could not reach the step (no notebook card, no second login) write SKIP and why. A blank item is NOT accepted.

steps: Open any canvas you own and click the AI credits gauge in the top bar.
Read the popover, then open Settings and AI usage and read the same numbers there.
items.expect: Gauge and Settings both show remaining, "N AI credits every month", used, a bar and exactly "Renews on October 31, 5:00 PM PDT". N is 2,500 (account that never used AI) or 5,000 (account that used AI in October). No dollar sign or dollar amount anywhere.
items.fail: Any dollar amount, NaN, empty meter, a different renewal date, or a zero/red balance while credits remain.
items.record: N seen, remaining, used, exact renewal text, which login (gmail or amazon).

steps: Open a canvas that already has a notebook card, keep the right panel open, View menu > Study, pick the reference card, leave the working view on Canvas.
Drag the notebook card's bottom-right corner to make it clearly bigger, then reload the page at once.
Repeat after waiting 3 seconds, then sign out and in again and look at the notebook.
items.expect: The bigger size is kept after the immediate reload, the waited reload and after sign out and in. Study is still on.
items.fail: The notebook returns to its old size, or another card changes size.
items.record: Which canvas, which of the three reloads (if any) lost the size, browser.

items.feature: Chat restore keeps what you typed (C17 and G4)
steps: Open a canvas that already has a saved Chat thread, reload, and as soon as the composer shows type: draft 1026 (do not press Send).
Wait 10 seconds while the old thread loads.
items.expect: The typed text is still in the composer, not blanked or replaced when the old thread appears. A new chat starts in Auto with no leftover attached cards.
items.fail: The typed text disappears or is replaced when the thread loads.
items.record: Canvas, how fast you typed after reload, what the composer held at 10 seconds.

steps: Open Explore and press Star on one published canvas (yours, "prod-check 9f178ce5 composer", is fine): Starred fills, the count goes up by 1, you stay on the page.
Reload: still starred, same count. Library > Stars lists it.
Press Star again to unstar, reload: gone from Stars, count back.
items.expect: Star and count survive reload; Library > Stars lists it; unstar removes it.
items.fail: Count differs after reload, the star vanishes, or a private canvas shows in anyone's Stars.
items.record: Canvas, counts before/during/after. Tell the integrator the time: a public re-probe must then show star_history_since not null (it stays set after unstar, by design).
items.followup: INTEGRATOR re-probes P20, P21, P18 and records star_count and star_history_since.

items.feature: Focus on a card and Escape
steps: In the throwaway canvas (or any canvas) select a notebook, PDF or image card and click Focus (or right-click the card > Focus).
Press Escape (or Back to canvas).
items.expect: The card fills the working area; after Escape the card, zoom and selection are exactly as before and there is no unsaved-change notice.
items.fail: Layout or zoom not restored, or an unsaved-change notice appears.
items.record: Card type tried (list each), result per type.

steps: In "acceptance 1026" right-click a card > Add comment, type text, Send: a pin appears on the card.
Reply in the thread, then Resolve it: thread and pin hide.
items.expect: Pin appears, reply lands, Resolve hides thread and pin. No email address is shown on any message.
items.fail: No pin, reply missing, or any email shown.
items.record: What you saw at each of the three points.

items.feature: Comments with a second account (reply, reaction, edit history, attachment, mute, removal)
steps: Share > invite your other login by email; accept it there (open the /i link, enter the emailed code). In the second account @mention yourself in a reply: your account shows an unread dot WITHOUT reload.

React with an emoji (both sides see the chip without reload); edit your comment and click "edited" (earlier text listed); attach a small PNG (both see it), then delete that comment (picture gone for both).
Thread Notifications > Mute: the thread leaves the Library inbox. Share > People with access > Remove the second account: it can no longer open the canvas or the picture link.
items.expect: Every update arrives without a reload, the PNG loads for both and disappears on delete, the removed account reads nothing, no email address appears on any message.
items.fail: Anything needs a reload to appear, a removed member still reads anything, or any message shows an email.
items.record: Which sub-step failed first, which login is which.

steps: As the second account star your PUBLISHED canvas (your own star does not count), wait 1 minute.
Open Explore > Canvases: "Top canvases this week"; then the Creators tab; then type any word in search and clear it.
items.expect: Your canvas at rank 1 with its weekly star count; Creators shows you with 1 supporter; the section hides while searching and returns when cleared; no private canvas, email or id; the week is Oct 26 to Nov 1 (Pacific).
items.fail: A private or unpublished canvas appears, an email or id is shown, the week label is wrong, or it stays empty after 2 minutes.
items.record: Rank, counts, week label as shown, time you starred and time you looked.
items.followup: INTEGRATOR re-probes P21 and records canvases.entries and star_history_since.

items.feature: /motion routing and Motion failure wording (no Generate)
steps: In the Chat composer type /motion and send: read what appears.
Open the canvas that holds your failed Motion job of 10-25 (job 61f70171) and read the card.
items.expect: /motion shows either the Motion proposal asking what to explain (acceptance account) or "Motion generation is temporarily unavailable while ..." (other account); no credits change. The failed card says it failed and shows its charge line. The refund has not been run yet, so a charge line (about 127.8 credits) is EXPECTED today; record exactly what it says.
items.fail: A video starts, credits drop, or the failed card says "No credits charged" while the usage ledger still charged 127.8.
items.record: Exact text of the notice and of the failed card's charge line.

steps: In "acceptance 1026" paste one https link (for example https://example.com) onto the canvas.
Choose Add webpage card in the "Paste a link" dialog and wait about 10 seconds.
Press Lock scrolling, scroll the card, then Refresh.
items.expect: A card with the page's title and a screenshot appears; scrolling is locked/unlocked by the toggle; Refresh recaptures. Pasting as text still works.
items.fail: Capture stays stuck, shows "The capture failed", or the card is blank.
items.record: URL used, seconds to capture, the state text if it failed.

items.spend: none expected for Add to canvas; watch the gauge if you pick Use as context
steps: Open the Start a rabbit hole dialog, add one small .md or .pdf file and one link.
Pick Add to canvas only and start.
Open the dialog again and use Start with a blank canvas.
items.expect: The summary counts the sources; the file lands as a card; the blank start opens an empty canvas and imports nothing from the list.
items.fail: The dialog loses the draft, the file does not land, or the blank start imports the sources.
items.record: Files used, cards created, gauge before and after.

steps: Open Settings and visit each page once.
Change one preference (for example the theme), reload, and confirm it stuck.
items.expect: Every Settings page opens without error; the changed preference persists; AI usage matches O01.
items.fail: A page errors or is blank, or the preference reverts.

items.feature: Explore, creators and card visuals (G4 batch)
steps: Open Explore: look for the dot grid, card Sizes 0 and 1, descriptions cut at about 340 characters.
Open Creators and a creator profile (/@yudhisteer): header, avatar and badge beside the @handle.
items.expect: Dot grid shows like Home and Library; cards are consistent at Size 0 and 1; the creators list is wide with the badge beside the handle.
items.fail: No dot grid, cards squeezed or overlapping, badge below the handle.
items.record: Anything that looks wrong, one screenshot.

items.feature: Disabled features stay disabled and say so
steps: In the Chat composer type /generate-image and read the answer; open the slash picker and look for it.
Click the microphone on a Tutor answer and read what it says.
items.expect: /generate-image is not offered and a typed line answers that image generation is not available (and /image searches for real photos). The microphone says "Voice mode is paused".
items.fail: /generate-image offers a Generate button or a credits quote, or the microphone starts recording.

steps: Delete "acceptance 1026" (Trash, then delete for good) and confirm Library > Stars no longer lists it.
If you starred a public canvas in O04, confirm it is unstarred.
items.expect: The throwaway canvas and its comments, stars and attachment are gone.
items.fail: It remains in Trash or in Stars.

items.feature: CAD Focus (only if you already have a CAD card)
items.spend: none (do NOT create a CAD model: executor budget is 96.3% reserved until Nov 1)
steps: Open a canvas that already holds a CAD card, select it, click Focus.
Look at the Focus header, then press Escape.
items.expect: The model fills the working area with Interact and Fit view in the header (Show dimensions appears only for models with brief controls); Escape restores everything.
items.fail: Blank viewer, a missing header, or the layout not restored.
items.record: Which tools showed. SKIP if you have no CAD card.
